# Hourglass

![Hourglass](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/hourglass.png)

+30% Heads when 3 or fewer coins are left. Tails: goes back into the pile.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 40%
- **Shop price:** 10 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 4 points

## Tails
Goes back into the pile

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
